dogecoin.text: Remember when most people ignored @Bitcoin before and shrugged it off? Don't ignore @dogecoin this time!!

Because of the ongoing Dogecoin skyrocketing, I was able to witness my very human nature of desire.

Grabe, I'd be consumed by greed if it weren't for my spiritual learnings.

I think I had enough harvests already. I'll let my remaining Doges grow on my account. Goodnight! 🐕🤓
